alerts.title: Weight Gain on TLD
alerts.message: Guidelines suggest discussing weight gain possibility when starting ART. Patient has gained significant weight since starting TLD, with a current BMI of 32.4 kg/m². This could be attributed to the medication, but other factors like diet and exercise should also be considered. Acanthosis nigricans and elevated fasting glucose also suggest insulin resistance, a potential side effect of certain ART regimens.

evidence.recommended_action: Monitor weight, provide diet and exercise advice
